Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Pallavi - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vinod - 44 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Vinod stand near him.]

Vinod: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav walks across the courtyard.]

Pallavi (gently): "Hmm, I see."

[Aarav hides behind the tree.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

[Aarav waves goodbye to Mother.]

Aarav (excited): "Yes, all right."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Aarav (surprised): "What happened?"

[The sun rises over the village.]

Pallavi (softly): "That was fun!"

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Pallavi (excited): "One more time!"

[Aarav pats his horse.]

Aarav: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Aarav stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[The mist slowly clears.]

Aarav (laughing): "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Pallavi and Vinod stand near him.]

Aarav: "Dad, look over here."

[Aarav reads a storybook.]

Aarav: "Show me too!"

[Aarav writes in his notebook.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[Aarav does his homework at the table.]

Aarav (surprised): "Yes, all right."

[Aarav talks to his father on the phone.]

Vinod: "Show me too!"

[Aarav's phone rings and he answers it.]

Pallavi: "One more time!"

[Aarav types on his laptop.]

Aarav: "Careful!"

[Aarav watches cartoons on TV.]

Aarav (happily): "Really?"

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Aarav stands by the road. Pallavi and Vinod stand near him.]

Vinod: "Pallavi, look over here."

[Aarav rides his bicycle down the road.]

Aarav: "Exactly right."

[Aarav gets into the car.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

[Aarav gets on the bus.]

Aarav (happily): "Yes, of course."

[Aarav gets off the school bus.]

Aarav: "Really?"

[Aarav hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Aarav (surprised): "What a day to remember!"
